verdict.rationale: ImageMagick's own docs claim API bindings for C, C++, Python, .NET and Node.js and say developers can integrate it into applications, so it does offer SDK-style building surfaces. The evidence is one brief vendor line, though: it does not say which bindings are first-party versus community-maintained, and gives no SDK docs, versioning or hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: confirmation that each listed binding is official and maintained, per-language SDK documentation and reference, independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the bindings.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Extensive APIs Bindings for C, C++, Python, .NET, Node.js.
Developers can integrate ImageMagick into applications to perform tasks such as resizing, color correction, format conversion, and complex image transformations.
